title: All Libraries And Dependencies
body:
# **All Libraries And Dependencies**
![LINE](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/914f021a781c73d9dac4c6d4cea84ec8c8aa9c9b.png)

## Purpose
This modpack **adds all necessary libraries and dependencies**, making it easier for you to download, edit, and view your mod and resource pack list with clarity. By packing all the libraries together,

![Pack Them!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/50b87435ad9ffe520a824f3186ab67e427aa61f4.png)
**Now you just need to download mods and then edit them with ease. Isn't that satisfying?**

## Features
- **All popular necessary libraries/dependencies**
  - Fabric API
  - Yet Another Config Lib
  - Skyboxify (Custom skyes)
  - EMF/ETF (Entity customization)
  - OptiGUi (GUI customization)
  - **And Alot More...**

- **Some Essentials** (Based on Fabulously Optimized)
  - Performance optimizations 
    - Sodium/Lithium rendering
    - Entity/Particles Culling
    - Memory Usage optimization
  - Some HUD improvements
  - Dynamic Lights
  - Shader Support
  - Controller Support
  - Connected textures
  - Zooming
  - No Telemetry
  - Better Screenshots quality
  - Delete worlds to trash bin fix
  - e4mc ( Let your friends join your world )
- You can disable any mods that you don't like from modrinth.
 
- These are a small portion of the mods, Some may also be missing in future updates due to the developers.
- It's not a lot a lot, the entire modpack contains 72* mods and libraries,                 
**while the Fabulously Optimized modpack has 48\* Mods.**

## FAQ

- Q: What is this mod pack?
  - A: This modpack exists to help you view, edit, or delete mods with clarity, free from any libraries or dependencies.
                                                        
- Q: i don't like some mods that you installed how can i remove them?
  - <details><summary>A: </summary>
    Click on Content button at the modpack page.
  
    ![w](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d08a56fe1c340f3f1cd0f68a41f4489d442ca848.png)
    now search for the mods that you don't like and disable them.

    ![w](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8622b70a4cadf57f9eadc85a3e42378ddd3851b2.png)

    </details>
 
**If you encounter any issues, reach out to me on my Discord ( _zya4d_ )**
